top_signals.title: Bessent-He Talks Set the Stage for Trump-Xi Summit
top_signals.summary: “Bloomberg: The China Show” is your definitive source for news and analysis on the world's second-biggest economy. From politics and policy to tech and trends, Yvonne Man and David Ingles give global investors unique insight, delivering in-depth discussions with the newsmakers who matter.  (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: EM Investors Are Favoring Local Bonds as Dollar Debt Lags
top_signals.summary: Emerging-market investors are for now sticking with local-currency sovereign debt as surging Treasury yields dim the appeal of dollar-denominated developing-nation bonds.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
